pushEnableBody: Allow notifications for attendance reminders, advance updates, and salary alerts.
permissionRequiredBody: You must allow notifications to open the notification area.
permissionRequiredTwaBody: App notifications must be enabled to view this area. You should see a system prompt on first launch; if you missed it, open settings below.
permissionTwaSettingsHint: If the button does not work: Settings → Apps → CrewLedger → Notifications
permissionDeniedBody: Notification permission was denied. Enable notifications for CrewLedger in your device or browser settings, then refresh this page.
permissionDeniedTwaBody: App notifications are off. Go to Settings → Apps → CrewLedger → Notifications and turn them on.
permissionUnsupportedBody: This device does not support push notifications. Use a compatible browser or app to access notifications.
settingsSubtitle: Sound and mute preferences are saved on this device.
settingsMuteHint: When on, in-app alerts and sound are off; the list still updates.
settingsSoundHint: Play a short bip on new notifications.
settingsChangeSoundHint: Tap a sound to preview and select it.
